text: {"lessons":["My account fell from about 100,000 to 94,557 despite earlier gains, so I should prepare for losses as well as growth and avoid judging a plan by one month.","I bought more of Stock A and added Stock E, then held through later declines; I should set clear reasons and limits for each position rather than add without reassessing risk.","With an apartment goal, I should balance investing with keeping enough cash for flexibility and make decisions based on a long-term plan, not frequent account checks."]}
